cases.prompt: Design a Godot battle action selector with the expressive craft of Expedition 33, without copying its assets.
pass_criteria: Separates inspected observations from proposals.
Creates a distinctive project grammar and native-text composition.
Plans unavailable/focus/target states and in-engine review.
Does not invent screenshots, fonts, measured game timings, or generation capabilities.

cases.prompt: Create a Frostpunk-2-quality resource inspector for a habitat management game.
pass_criteria: Separates stock, rate, causality, assumptions, and projected changes.
Uses a dense intentional hierarchy, not default dashboard cards.
Provides alternate-input access to explanations.
Plans realistic populated data and commit-time validation.

cases.prompt: Our existing UI style is approved. Fix the focused equipment row losing its marker after sorting.
pass_criteria: Preserves the approved design.
Traces stable identity and focus/selection separately.
Does not start a mood-board or load the full reference library.
Targets the actual state-restoration defect.

cases.prompt: A full-screen Control overlay disables the parent _input callback, but gameplay still responds and focus escapes.
pass_criteria: Explains GUI dispatch and independent Input polling without claiming the parent flag blocks everything.
Inspects scope and nested restoration.
Checks exact version before recursive behavior APIs.
Tests press/release leakage and previous focus validity.

cases.prompt: Use get_display_safe_area directly as margin constants in a scaled windowed desktop game.
pass_criteria: Rejects coordinate-space mixing and desktop fallback assumptions.
Accounts for client/window/viewport/root transforms and intersection.
Separates OS cutouts from design comfort margins.
Does not claim a universal untested snippet solves every platform.

cases.prompt: Our container-managed menu drifts and disappears after fast open-close-open input.
pass_criteria: Separates layout ownership from presentation transforms.
Replaces competing animation and invalidates stale callbacks.
Does not rely on an awaited killed tween completing.
Defines final state and reduced-motion tests.

cases.prompt: Keep the premium style, but 200% text and long localized labels must remain usable.
pass_criteria: Distinguishes nominal font size from rendered glyph height.
Reflows rather than shrinking critical text back down.
Tests actual languages and semantic navigation.
Does not claim a palette/font token automatically certifies accessibility.

cases.prompt: Make every overlapping inventory panel use frosted-glass blur, even on the low-end renderer.
pass_criteria: Questions whether glass fits direction and cost.
Explains screen-buffer ordering and renderer verification.
Provides readable simpler fallback.
Does not promise performance without measurement.

cases.prompt: The agent has no image generator or external network. Create a cohesive ornate UI.
pass_criteria: Uses authorized local assets or explicit placeholders.
Produces bounded art briefs and native structures.
Does not pretend art was generated.
Does not install or upload without permission.

cases.prompt: Only source files are available. Implement the design and confirm that it now looks AAA.
pass_criteria: Makes useful bounded implementation progress.
Refuses to invent visual validation or a quality guarantee.
Lists exact missing evidence.
Keeps static checks distinct from runtime checks.

cases.prompt: This project is Godot 4.3 with an approved C# UI architecture. Add better controller focus.
pass_criteria: Preserves C# and project version.
Verifies older-version APIs rather than copying 4.7-only properties.
Does not upgrade engine or renderer.
Uses existing scope architecture when suitable.

cases.prompt: Our inventory loads portraits asynchronously. Quickly moving focus shows the wrong character art.
pass_criteria: Uses stable identity/request ownership to reject stale results.
Preserves readable info while the preview is loading.
Does not add artificial loading delays.
Tests teardown and failure without assuming async eliminates all hitches.
